notes: Largest US defense prime. Four segments (Aeronautics, MFC, RMS, Space). 10-K explicitly names F-35 (26% of total consolidated net sales / 64% of Aeronautics 2023), PAC-3, THAAD, HIMARS/GMLRS, JASSM/LRASM/PrSM/Hellfire, Javelin, Apache fire control, SOF GLSS, hypersonics, Aegis BMD/C2BMC/LCS, Sikorsky helicopters (BLACK HAWK, CH-53K, CRH, VH-92A), Next-Gen OPIR, Trident II D5 FBM, Orion, Next Generation Interceptor (NGI), GPS III, SDA Transport Layer. We use J-Book PEs from the FY26 books (post-cutoff publication) only as a forward-funding lens — we are testing whether the framework would have flagged divergence, not whether LMT 'should have known' the FY26 numbers at filing time.
